title: AIID 1680: Prompt injection in Cline's Claude-powered issue triager led to an unauthorised npm release
summary: An unknown actor used prompt injection against Cline's Claude-powered GitHub issue-triage workflow, together with a GitHub Actions cache-poisoning path, to obtain npm publication credentials, and on February 17, 2026 a still-valid npm token was used to publish an unauthorised cline@2.3.0 whose postinstall script installed OpenClaw without user intent. Cline deprecated the release and revoked the token the same day and reported no evidence of user-data exposure; the database entry attaches five reports, including Cline's post-mortem and a GitHub security advisory listing 2.3.0 as affected and 2.4.0 as patched.
verification_note: AIID entry fetched 2026-10-17; incident date 2026-02-17 and the claims (prompt injection into the Claude-powered triage workflow, cache poisoning, cline@2.3.0 installing OpenClaw, same-day deprecation and token revocation, no user-data exposure) confirmed on the page. Cline's post-mortem (published 2026-02-24) was also fetched and is consistent. The AIID page does not state when the entry was added, so date is the incident date.
